Question
========
What is original thinking?

Answerlist
----------
* keeping number of used sources to a minimum
* original thinking can only be present in arts (e.g. poetry), while science and industry must rely on credible sources
* producing completely unique ideas and prioritizing novelty and relevance to the study field
* producing authentic work based on one’s own ideas, properly supported by sources


Solution
========
Original thinking means producing authentic work based on one’s own ideas, properly supported by sources


Answerlist
----------
* False

* False
* True
